messages:
customer_acme: Hey — our Feb invoice for acme-corp jumped massively (≈$2.1k -> $8.7k). We traced it to a handful of API calls where the SDK estimator reports ~120k tokens but the invoice shows ~380k. Can someone escalate?

metering-bot: Metering alert: detected >3x billing delta for acct `acme-corp` on 2026-02-27. Trace id: trace-20260227-09.

support_alex: Sorry about the hit — thanks for flagging. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl + headers) and a sample SDK estimator log? Also need request id or trace id.

customer_acme: Putting the curl and SDK output in-line. Request id in the server logs is `req_8f3d2b`. Sample curl (redacted key):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"rw-4-32k","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize these 10k tokens of customer logs."}],"stream":false}'
```

SDK local estimator log (snippet):

```
estimator: prompt_tokens=4500, completion_tokens=700, total=5200
estimator: running total for batch: 119800
```

But invoice shows ~380k tokens billed for the same span (we cross-checked invoice line items).

support_alex: Thanks, forwarding to billing + runtime. @billing_maya @runtime_tom please triage — customer provided request id.

billing_maya: Looking now. Quick note: invoices include all tokens touched by the server, not just tokens returned in the final API response. That includes any server-inserted messages, tool hooks, and pre/post processing. Can you confirm whether you used any function-calls / tool integrations?

customer_acme: We do use a small post-processing tool (internal) that the runtime can call via the `tool` feature to summarize and append a short summary. It's meant to be a tiny extra step — but we didn't expect large overhead. The SDK estimator didn't show any toolcall tokens.

runtime_tom: This looks like the likely cause. We recently rolled a change where the runtime may invoke configured tool hooks after the main completion (a follow-up assistant message with `role: assistant` + function_call) for async postprocessing in certain batches. Those follow-ups are executed server-side and are not streamed back to the client in some cases (especially when `stream=false`). They still consume tokens and are billed. If the tool returns a long summary or echoes the original prompt context as part of its call, that can multiply tokens.

eng_sre_rita: To confirm, do you have the full server-side trace for `req_8f3d2b`? We need the sequence of internal messages that were processed. If the runtime injected a hidden assistant message, it'll show in the trace as `assistant_internal`/`toolcall`.

customer_acme: Trace attached (short):

```
req_8f3d2b:
  client messages: system (4500 tokens), user (5000 tokens)
  runtime: forwarded to model rw-4-32k -> completion (700 tokens)
  runtime: post-tool-hook invoked `summarizer-v2` -> tool prompt (45k tokens) -> tool completion (60k tokens)
  runtime: telemetry helper added assistant followup (2k tokens)
```

devex_liam: Two quick things: 1) SDK estimator currently only totals tokens it can compute locally from the request + response stream. It explicitly doesn't include server-side injected tokens or hidden tool interactions. 2) We recently added a server header `x-rw-metering-delta` in experimental for some accounts that returns "server_injected_tokens" so SDKs can surface a closer estimate. Do you see that header in your curl/SDK responses?

customer_acme: We didn't notice `x-rw-metering-delta` in responses. Our SDK (v0.9.3) doesn't surface it.

runtime_tom: That explains it. For this account, the runtime enabled post-processing tool hooks (`summarizer-v2`) for higher-quality outputs in some large-batch jobs. The tool prompt above (45k tokens) is generated by the runtime by concatenating parts of the original context + extra template text. The SDK estimator doesn't see that because it runs client-side only and the tool call is internal.

billing_maya: Actionable options for customer:
- We can credit the differential for Feb as a one-time courtesy while you audit the tool hook usage (if you believe it's unintended).
- Disable post-processing tool hooks for your workspace (can flip in Console or via support).
- Move to a dedicated runtime policy that prevents server-side tool chaining for your account.

customer_acme: We didn't expect the tool to re-embed the whole context. Oops. Could you recommend a fix?

runtime_tom: Short-term: disable `summarizer-v2` for your app (Console > Integrations > Tool Hooks). Medium-term: we will add a runtime safeguard to truncate or re-tokenize tool prompts to avoid re-sending full 10k+ context verbatim; also add clearer telemetry about tool-generated token cost.

devex_liam: Workarounds for SDK users:
- Update SDK to v0.9.5 (coming) which surfaces `x-rw-metering-delta` and an endpoint `GET /v1/metering/preview?request_id=req_8f3d2b` that returns server-injected token counts (for non-sensitive metadata only).
- For streaming users, check for a `metering.delta` event in the stream (we'll expand this).

eng_sre_rita: @runtime_tom can you capture the internal plan and give us the exact token breakdown per phase for the trace? We'll attach to the billing ticket.

runtime_tom: Captured and uploaded. Breakdown: client prompt processed: 9500 tokens; model completion: 700 tokens; tool prompt generation (runtime): 45,120 tokens; tool completion: 60,350 tokens; telemetry assistant followup: 2,030 tokens. Total server-processed tokens: 108,700 for that single `req_8f3d2b` (but since they ran this pattern many times it explains the multiplier).

billing_maya: Filing billing adjustment request. Pending: customer confirmation to disable hooks or accept one-time credit.

customer_acme: Please do the credit for Feb and we'll disable the hook immediately. Also would appreciate a short doc explaining what counts as "server-injected" tokens so we can tune our integration. :pray:

support_alex: Understood — passing to billing to issue credit. @devex_liam we'll need the doc and SDK patch released ASAP.

devex_liam: On it — I'll draft a KB: "Understanding server-injected tokens (tool hooks, telemetry, post-processing)" and ship SDK v0.9.5 with the header/endpoint. ETA: 3 business days.

metering-bot: Ticket RW-BILL-442 created for adjustment; owner: billing_maya.

support_alex: Thanks everyone. Closing loop once billing completes and SDK/docs are live. :white_check_mark:
